allow.why: values-free templates. 2026-10-30 orchestrator: cat docs/templates/nas-mounts/smb-credentials.cred.template was denied by the 'credentials' indicator

residual: The floor is lexical. The plugin takes the whitespace-delimited token around an indicator, so 'cat .env;x.template' is one token whose basename matches *.template. The same class already exists without any allowlist ('cat${IFS}.env' is not matched). Upstream fix proposed: split tokens on ; | & < > ( ) as well.
A verb in one segment and an indicator in another still deny ('ls .env.example; grep x y' gives the token '.env.example;'). That is the upstream verb/operand association bug, not an allowlist gap.

egress.why_not_enforced: 5.16.0 has no egress allowlist knob: isAllowlistedHost() hardcodes localhost/127.0.0.1. The only switch is HARNESS_RUNTIME_FLOOR_EGRESS=off, which disables the whole category and is inherited by codex/cursor launched from a Claude Bash call. Do not set it.
known_false_negatives_upstream: scp ./build deploy@203.0.113.7:/srv/ is allowed: remoteHostPattern needs a letter TLD, so a raw IP destination is never matched
rsync -a ./out/ 198.51.100.4:/srv/out/ is allowed for the same reason
ssh evo-x2 'nc -z 192.168.11.23 445' is allowed: the quoted 'nc token is not equal to nc
observed_false_positives_2026_10_30: nc -z -G 3 -w 3 192.168.11.23 445 (and even nc -z -G 3 127.0.0.1 22): the token after nc is the flag -z, read as the host
rsync -a --delete ./snap-before/ ./snap-after/ && cp CLAUDE.md x/: a local copy; CLAUDE.md looks like a host because .md is a ccTLD
scp scripts/e2e/run.sh jetson-thor:ets/ && ssh jetson-thor 'python -m engineai_thor_sidecar.cli run': the module name is read as the host
python3 heredoc whose body mentions rsync and a *.sh file: egress does not strip heredoc bodies (secret-read does)
curl -s http://192.168.11.28:4000/health and curl -s http://evo-x2:8080/v1/models: cluster LAN/tailnet hosts, no allowlist knob
